title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber II Cap. 13 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber II De modo & necessario consequente atque fine — ultimo judicio COMPLETE (423–mid-430).
